title: Word Count
prompt: Write count_words(text) returning the number of words (whitespace-separated).

tests.name: counts words
tests.code:
assert count_words("to be or not to be") == 6
assert count_words("") == 0, "empty text has no words"
assert count_words("   ") == 0, "whitespace only is zero"
tests.hint: text.split() already handles all whitespace and returns [] for empty.
